glosses: off the top of one's head, Thesaurus:impromptu

examples.text: Экспромтом написал я вам эти стихи, любезная Софья Александровна, и не имею духу продолжать таким образом.
He must also be fluent in obscenity, offhand in sex. Most important of all, he must play tough.

glosses: Careless; without sufficient thought or consideration.

examples.text: He doesn't realise how hurtful his offhand remarks can be.

In September 2019, on the papal plane en route to Mozambique, Francis acknowledged the sharp opposition he faced from conservative detractors in the United States in an offhand remark. He said, it was “an honor that the Americans attack me.”
She was quite offhand with me yesterday.

glosses: Right away, immediately, without thinking about it.

examples.text: Offhand, I'd guess that that's a yellow-bellied sapsucker.
We will have no more of this shilly-shallying! Call the Archbishop, and let the Prince and Princess be married offhand!

glosses: In an abrupt or unfriendly manner.
Created on the spur of the moment; impromptu.

examples.text: Over the past 20 years or so, from South America to the Danube basin, ad hoc coalitions of politicians, activists and conscience-stricken billionaires (whose core activities, such as Povlsen’s clothing business, are often less than environmentally friendly), have rewilded millions of acres of mostly failed agricultural and grazing land.

glosses: Postulated solely to save a theory from being falsified, without making any new predictions.

examples.text: Contrary to the traditional condoning of ad hoc hypotheses, and in line with Popper's and Grünbaum's approaches, we see, once an ad hoc hypothesis is introduced we are unhappy about it and try to eliminate it.

glosses: Independent of previously instated network structure, like routers or access points.

examples.text: An ad hoc network is a group of wireless mobile nodes dynamically forming a temporary network without any fixed infrastructure or centralized administration. The applications for ad hoc networks have grown tremendously with the increase in the use of wireless sensor networks.

glosses: On the spur of the moment.
Carried out with no preparation; impromptu.
aus eigenem inneren Antrieb, ohne Planung, ohne lange Überlegung

examples.text: Am letzten Urlaubstag entschlossen sie sich spontan, noch eine Woche länger zu bleiben.

„Was tut nun Lourdes mit den Massen? Es versetzt zunächst die fernen Kranken durch seine Reputation, die künstlich genährt und gesteigert wird, in sanften Schwindel. Die Wallfahrten sind ja nicht spontan, sondern sorgfältig organisiert, ihre Beteiligung ist häufig unter mehr oder minder starker Beeinflussung erfolgt.“

glosses: ohne äußere Anregung, ohne äußeren Einfluss, aus sich selbst heraus

examples.text: Die Hälfte aller befruchteten Eizellen geht spontan zu Grunde.

glosses: ohne Vorbereitung, speziell für einen Zweck oder spontan aus einer Situation heraus entstanden

examples.text: Wir haben natürlich auch noch mehr tolle Sachen gemacht – die fallen mir aber ad hoc nicht ein.
Keiner war vorbereitet, die Krise trat ad hoc auf.
